class.name: RealitySceneTree
class.brief_description: Synchronizes Godot scenes with RealityKit and opens additional 3D volumes.
class.description: This scene tree synchronizes Godot scene changes with RealityKit. On visionOS, an additional volume can run its own scene and [World3D] alongside the main scene.

method.name: open_volume_window
method.description: Creates an additional volumetric window containing a separate instance of the packed scene at [param scene_path]. Returns its window ID, or [code]-1[/code] if unavailable or the scene cannot be loaded. The scene and its [World3D] remain alive when the window closes.

method.name: reopen_volume_window
method.description: Reopens the volume created by [method open_volume_window] with the given ID. An unknown ID has no effect.
